summary: Backend: 11/11 pytest cases passed covering upload (image-only 400), list newest-first, assign to pole+underground with dedup+404/400 branches, unassign pulls from staged_photos, delete gallery record leaves assigned copies, and zip export contains 'Job Photos/' entries for unassigned photos. Frontend Playwright: logged in as Admin, opened seed job A050ABC, confirmed Job Files + Job Photo Gallery cards render side-by-side on desktop, uploaded image via job-gallery-file-input -> thumb-0 appeared with 'Unassigned' label, selected + opened gallery-assign-dialog (4 items visible), assigned to first item -> green tag appeared, untagged -> 'Unassigned' returned, viewer dialog opened with assign+delete buttons, delete removed the thumb (count=0).

issues: Radix a11y console warning: `DialogContent` (job-gallery-viewer and gallery-assign-dialog) is missing a `DialogTitle`. Wrap a hidden title with VisuallyHidden to satisfy screen readers.

action_items: Add a (visually hidden) DialogTitle to JobPhotoGallery viewer Dialog and JobPhotoAssignDialog to remove Radix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: files.py assign_job_gallery_photo: reads item with projection {'_id':0,'id':1} then checks truthiness — works, but doesn't validate that item.job_id == job_id explicitly (filter already scopes by job_id, so OK).
delete_job_gallery_photo intentionally does not clean up storage objects; acceptable per spec (assigned copies remain via items).
JobPhotoGallery.jsx uploads photos sequentially in a for-of loop; fine for small batches but could be parallelized for larger uploads.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted a fresh test job (TEST_gallery_iter53) with 1 pole + 1 underground for destructive backend tests. Uploaded+deleted 1 photo against seed job A050ABC during UI test (cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Job Photo Gallery feature validated end-to-end. Only remaining item is a11y title on the two Dialogs. Reusable pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_job_photo_gallery.py.
